sourceTitle: The Covent Garden Theatre, or Pasquin Turn'd Drawcansir
description: "The Covent Garden Theatre, or Pasquin Turn'd Drawcansir" by Charles Macklin is a satirical play written in the mid-18th century. This work serves as an afterpiece, a genre characterized by short comedic performances added to longer theatrical presentations during the period.
